name: PHONE
title: Prompt pack 2: computational smartphone photo
summary: Makes every picture look like a real phone photo: vertical 9:16, deep focus, mobile HDR and tone mapping, no studio or cinematic look. Taken by another person from 1.5 to 2 m away, so the phone's wide lens does not enlarge the face. Style shots are framed from the waist up to fix the face-too-big problem. The face, frame-front and temple paragraphs are locked and identical to PP1.
phone_look: Computational mobile-photo rendering, vertical 9:16 smartphone capture, small-sensor deep depth of field, short wide-angle optics, multi-frame mobile HDR, local tone mapping, edge-aware digital sharpening, mild denoising, compressed tonal rolloff, slight computational contrast, natural highlight rolloff, everyday candid phone realism. This should look like a real smartphone photo, not a DSLR image, not a studio shot, and not a polished stock image. Avoid shallow depth of field, avoid cinematic lighting, avoid perfect composition.

tryon.task: Create an everyday smartphone photo of this customer wearing exactly this eyewear.
tryon.shot: Shot: {pose_line} Relaxed neutral expression, eyes looking into the lens, plain dark grey crew-neck T-shirt. Vertical 9:16 photo framed from the chest up, with natural head-to-shoulder proportions. Plain white wall behind, lit by soft daylight from a window. Taken by another person with a phone's main camera at eye level, about 1.5 m away: not a selfie, so the face is not stretched by the wide lens. The eyes, the frame and the temple arm are sharp.

scene.task: Create an everyday smartphone photo of this customer {scene}.{custom}
scene.shot: Shot: vertical 9:16 photo framed from the waist up, with natural head-to-shoulder proportions, the face about a fifth of the picture's width, and a little open space above the head. Taken by a friend with a phone's main camera at chest height, about 2 m away: not a selfie, so the face is not stretched by the wide lens. The setting behind stays recognisable and mostly in focus. Light: {light}.

look.render: Keep it the same smartphone photo as Image 1, with the same sharpness, noise, tone mapping and colour. Do not add grain, smoothing or extra sharpening, and leave everything away from the eyewear exactly as it is.
